question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.amount,
        p.payment_date,
        cfp.first_payment_date,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cfp.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_diff
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cfp ON p.customer_id = cfp.customer_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.customer_id,
        cl.total_ltv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cp.hours_diff >= 0 AND cp.hours_diff < 168 THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cp.hours_diff >= 0 AND cp.hours_diff < 720 THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30days
    FROM customer_payments cp
    JOIN customer_ltv cl ON cp.customer_id = cl.customer_id
    GROUP BY cp.customer_id, cl.total_ltv
    HAVING cl.total_ltv > 0
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * ltv_7days / total_ltv * 100) as avg_pct_7days,
    AVG(1.0 * ltv_30days / total_ltv * 100) as avg_pct_30days,
    AVG(total_ltv) as avg_ltv
FROM customer_metrics

-- First, let's build per-customer data with first payment date, total LTV, and check the hour difference
WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.amount,
        p.payment_date,
        cfp.first_payment_date,
        -- Hours between payment and first payment
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cfp.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_diff
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cfp ON p.customer_id = cfp.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cp.customer_id,
    cp.first_payment_date,
    cl.total_ltv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cp.hours_diff >= 0 AND cp.hours_diff < 168 THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cp.hours_diff >= 0 AND cp.hours_diff < 720 THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30days,
    COUNT(*) as num_payments
FROM customer_payments cp
JOIN customer_ltv cl ON cp.customer_id = cl.customer_id
GROUP BY cp.customer_id, cp.first_payment_date, cl.total_ltv
HAVING cl.total_ltv > 0
ORDER BY cp.customer_id
LIMIT 10
